The team will be AI-first in two meaningful ways: using AI to drive engineering productivity and strong engineering discipline, and building a product that applies AI in genuinely innovative ways to problems that matter. You'll have significant ownership over the QA process, documentation and tools in a startup-like setting. This role is for a hands-on, self-starter who thrives on balancing performance, cost, and reliability. Within your first 3 months, you will have live customers on the platform and a thriving, growing team behind it - directly accelerating how customers bring life-saving products to market.

jobs.title: Senior Safety Domain Expert - Falcon
jobs.location_raw: United Kingdom - London · France - Paris · Massachusetts - Boston · Germany - Berlin · Canada - Toronto
jobs.description_text: The Role We are looking for an experienced pharmacovigilance professional to serve as our Senior Safety Domain Expert for Veeva Falcon. In this role, you will bridge hands-on case processing execution with high-level strategic vision for the future of PV Operations, directly shaping next-generation AI and automation tools. You will spend your days collaborating with our internal technical teams and external early adopters, acting as the definitive "Voice of the Customer" to ensure our platform delivers flawless safety automation.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Full Stack
jobs.description_text: The Role This is a top software engineering job that incorporates everything you’ve worked so hard for. And with the mission of creating cloud software that helps speed up the innovation and delivery of critical treatments and medicines to patients around the globe, it simply doesn’t get any more important than this. Your impact as a technical problem-solver will mean you will be focused on building software that can not only scale for heavy use, but that can also evolve with new features and capabilities. You will have equal influence to drive the direction of the build, be an advisor to product leadership and mentor freshly minted software engineers in their new careers. We are looking for engineers that would thrive in a dynamic, startup environment while having the stability of a successful, profitable company. You have extensive experience in full-stack software development in Java and/or React. You’ve ideally worked in enterprise software development or for a high-growth technology company.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Consultant - English & Korean Speaking
jobs.location_raw: South Korea - Seoul · China - Dalian · China - Beijing
jobs.description_text: The Role Veeva Systems is looking for Senior Technical Consultants, who have strong technical and consulting background, and a passion for helping customers achieve their business vision, are wishing to participate in the transformation of the Life Sciences Industry and in addition are interested in learning all the details about Cloud System Management. Technical Consultants will work with regional and/or global service teams closely to build technical solutions including system integration to help deliver successful implementations. The Technical Consultants are members of our Professional Services (Consulting) Organization, providing Project and Post-Go-Live application consulting as a subject matter expert of Veeva Commercial and R&D Cloud products portfolio.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Consultant - R&D Cloud Solutions
jobs.description_text: The Role Shift your career from external consulting to vendor-side ownership. Go-live is only the baseline. Working directly for the software vendor means you own the long-term technical strategy and drive continuous platform evolution with direct access to the R&D engineers who write the code. In this strategic, advisory-led role, you will act as a Subject Matter Expert for Life Sciences leaders, ranging from emerging biotechs to global Top 20 Pharma. Focusing on either Veeva Clinical Operations or Veeva Regulatory,, you will lead complex platform architecture, drive legacy-to-cloud change management, and directly influence future product roadmaps from within our expanding CEE hub of 60+ consultants across Poland and Hungary supported by Veeva’s global network of 8,000+ professionals.

jobs.title: Services Engagement Manager - China R&D and Quality Services
jobs.description_text: The Role The Services Engagement Manager (SEM) is responsible for setting our R&D and Quality Cloud customers up for success and representing the entire value proposition and effort behind a R&D and Quality Cloud Implementation. This is a critical role in ensuring successful implementation and serves as an integral part of the sales cycle and during project delivery, acting as a solution expert working in close alignment with the Veeva Sales and Services Teams. With a passion for Software Implementation and expertise in Life Sciences R&D and Quality Sales, our ideal candidate will structure the right solution, set the right expectations, and identify the appropriate project charter; including staffing, timeframes, and associated costs. RFx Responses, and delivery of Proposals and Statements of Work (SOW) is a key deliverable from the SEM, along with strategic alignment of the team prior to project start.

jobs.title: Services Engagement Manager - ClinData
jobs.description_text: The Role The Services Engagement Manager (SEM) is responsible for setting our customers up for success and representing the entire value proposition and effort behind a Veeva ClinData Implementation. This is a critical role in ensuring successful customer engagements during the scoping and planning phase to establish the right strategy for implementation success. The SEM is an integral part of the sales cycle, acting as a solution expert working in close alignment with the Veeva Sales, Strategy, and Services Teams. Utilizing their own clinical trial systems experience and Veeva product knowledge, they will structure the right solution, set the right expectations, and identify the appropriate project charter, including staffing, timeframes, and associated costs. Delivery of Proposals and Statements of Work (SOW) is a key deliverable from the SEM, along with potential implementation partner recommendations and strategic alignment of the team prior to project start.

jobs.title: Solution Consultant - China Clinical Operations
jobs.description_text: The Role Veeva’s Solution Consultants are an integral part of our sales team, partnering with Market Strategies and Account Partners as product experts in the sales cycle. As a Solution Consultant for Clinical Operations, you will provide product and process expertise in the form of consultative discussions, demonstrations, tailored presentations, and conference room pilots with Veeva’s customers and prospects in China. This involves working to understand the clinical trial management and operational challenges of each customer, tailoring events to show how our Veeva Vault Clinical Suite (eTMF, CTMS, Study Training, Payment, Site Connect etc) meets those needs, articulating complex technical and regulatory concepts clearly, and effectively addressing customer questions and concerns.

jobs.title: Strategy Associate - Veeva Link
jobs.location_raw: United Kingdom - London · New York - New York City
jobs.description_text: The Role Veeva Link is transforming how the global life sciences industry connects with Key Opinion Leaders in Healthcare. Our applications span every stage of market maturity, from established industry standards to fast-growing emerging solutions, so there is always something new to learn and real room to grow. Our Strategy team owns the market success of our products, from shaping product direction to making sure customers realise lasting value. We are now expanding the Strategy team with a new client value function, and we are looking for a highly motivated Strategy Associate to join the team. Working side by side with our Strategy Directors, you will take direct ownership of client engagement across some of the world's leading pharmaceutical companies. You will build trusted relationships with key stakeholders, equip client teams to get the most from our products, and drive day-to-day product adoption. Along the way, you will analyze user engagement trends, turn end-user insights into input for our product roadmap, and show clients how our products deliver measurable business impact.

jobs.title: Technical Consultant - RTSM
jobs.description_text: Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead. At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors. Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities. The Role Veeva Systems, a leader in cloud-based solutions for the global life sciences industry, is looking for a Technical Consultant to join our RTSM (Randomization and Trial Supply Management) team. The Technical Consultant will write custom code for RTSM projects, helping customers expedite trials and bring treatments to patients faster.

jobs.description_text: The Role Level up your career with Veeva RTSM! Join our scaling team as a Technical Operations Support Engineer and help power our world-class IRT/RTSM platform. If you're an ambitious engineer ready for startup style energy backed by a stable, growing public company, this is your opportunity to drive immediate impact and scale your career.

jobs.title: Validation Analyst - RTSM
jobs.location_raw: South Korea - Busan · South Korea - Seoul
jobs.description_text: The Role We are looking for a Computer Software Validation (CSV) professional with a specialty in clinical trial software. This role would give you the opportunity to work on a leading solution in Randomization and Trial Supply Management (RTSM) software. To excel in this role, you will require strong technical writing capabilities and the ability to simplify complex topics. As a member of the RTSM team, you will work closely with Development and Project Management teams to support customer RTSM implementations in a dynamic environment. You will use your expertise to take ownership of the validation process for assigned projects and play an important role in building and maintaining product excellence for the RTSM system.

jobs.location_raw: Pennsylvania - Philadelphia · New York - New York City
jobs.description_text: The Role Crossix is positioned at the center of big data, innovative technology, media, and life sciences. Our mission is to empower life sciences companies with the data and insights they need to drive DTC and HCP marketing effectiveness and, ultimately, better patient outcomes. As part of Veeva, the Crossix team offers the agility of a high-growth team with the stability of a global leader. We are seeking a Vice President of Marketing to lead marketing for Crossix. As a member of the Crossix leadership team, you will partner closely with leaders in Sales, Product, and Strategy, while leading a lean team of product and field marketing professionals.

jobs.title: Compliance Manager
jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE ROLE Anyscale's security and compliance needs are growing as we work with larger and more demanding customers. Compliance is increasingly a customer-facing, contractual function rather than an internal exercise, and we are looking for someone to own it. This role owns that function end to end: our audits, our evidence base, our risk register, and the security diligence that customers put us through before and during a contract. You will work directly with the Head of Security and across engineering, IT, legal, and sales. This is a program-ownership role with the autonomy and accountability that implies. You will not have a senior compliance function above you to defer to; you are that function. In your first year, success looks like a complete and defensible evidence base with clean audit outcomes, a repeatable way to answer customer security diligence, and a risk register that leadership actually uses. jobs.title: Senior Detection and Response Engineer
jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE ROLE Anyscale's need to detect and respond to security events across its production and corporate environments is growing as the company scales. We're looking for a Senior Detection and Response Engineer to own detection engineering and to lead incident response when it counts, coordinating the response and driving it to resolution. You will own the detection pipeline, the response runbooks, and incident response, reporting to the Head of Security and partnering with engineering. This role is based in India. We're looking for a Senior Product Security Engineer to own our secure software development lifecycle and to be engineering's partner on building security into the product. You will own and operate a scalable SSDL, partner with engineering on security features and secure design, review the security of existing systems and new initiatives, and own how we find, track, drive to resolution and report on vulnerabilities in what we ship. This role is based in India. jobs.title: Analyste en Planification des Actifs
jobs.description_text: Chez Lyft, notre mission est de servir et de connecter. Nous y parvenons en favorisant un environnement de travail où chacun trouve sa place et a la possibilité de s'épanouir. Lyft Urban Solutions fournit les systèmes de vélos et de trottinettes en libre-service qui permettent à des millions de personnes de se déplacer dans plus de 60 villes à travers le monde. Nous avons créé le premier système de vélos en libre-service automatisé d'Amérique du Nord et restons à la pointe de la révolution de la micromobilité. Nos systèmes sont présents partout dans le monde : de Citi Bike à New York à BIXI à Montréal, en passant par Divvy à Chicago, Capital Bikeshare à Washington D.C., et des systèmes emblématiques à Austin, Barcelone, Bogota, Boston, Buenos Aires, Columbus, Détroit, Dubaï, Londres, Madrid, Mexico, Monaco, Pittsburgh, Portland, Rio de Janeiro, San Francisco, Toronto et bien d'autres villes. Nous ne sommes pas de simples fournisseurs de technologies : nous exploitons ces systèmes, en développant les logiciels, le matériel et les opérations qui permettent à la micromobilité urbaine de fonctionner à grande échelle. L'équipe de Lyft Urban Solutions à Montréal est en pleine croissance, et nous recherchons un(e) Analyste en planification des actifs. Ce rôle soutiendra la planification et l'allocation des pièces de rechange dans tous les marchés de micromobilité où Lyft est présente. jobs.title: AI-First Engineering Intern
jobs.description_text: Why This Role Exists Xsolla is going all-in on becoming an AI-first company, and we're not waiting for a slow rollout to get there. We're offering AI Engineer Internships in regions across the globe to help drive that shift directly, not by sitting in the back office, but by building. You'll work on two things: Internal AI initiatives – helping unlock AI tooling and integrations across Xsolla faster than our existing teams can alone. Proof-of-concept builds on our own APIs – showing our product and engineering teams what's possible when you build with AI as a core part of your workflow, not an afterthought. This isn't a shadow-and-observe internship. You'll ship code that goes to customers – internal teams or external players and game developers – working closely with senior engineers and fellow interns across our global regions. Who You'll Work With You won't be isolated on an intern-only project island. You'll work closely with senior engineers who are actively rebuilding how we write software, and you'll be part of a global cohort of interns building in parallel across our regions. That combination is the point: senior engineers give you a bar for what production-grade, customer-facing code looks like, and your fellow interns give you a peer group to trade ideas, code, and AI workflows every week.

jobs.title: Computational Scientist / Scientific Machine Learning
jobs.description_text: We are looking for a Computational Scientist specialized in Scientific Machine Learning (SciML) to join our team. This job is for you if you know how to write numerical solvers that are fast, correct and differentiable end to end, and want to see them run against real plasma data and inside real control systems. We are looking for a PhD-level or senior computational researcher for this role. Responsibilities Design, implement and validate differentiable solvers in JAX for plasma physics problems such as free-boundary equilibrium, transport and state estimation. Make them robust and fast enough for production use via advanced numerical techniques for differential equation time stepping, as well as optimization of GPU/TPU performance. Using automatic differentiation for model calibration against experimental data, parameter estimation and controller design and optimization, working with our data and control engineers. Code ownership: quality, testing, verification against reference solutions, packaging and documentation. Requirements Substantial code written in a differentiable framework. Our stack is in JAX, Julia or PyTorch experts are very welcome if they’re happy to switch. Strong background in numerical methods for ODEs and PDEs: discretisation, stiff and implicit solvers, nonlinear and sparse linear solvers. Demonstrated ability to operate at the frontier of SciML, Universal Differential Equations, Neural ODEs, and other emerging hybrid data-driven/mechanistic paradigms.

jobs.description_text: We are looking for a Data / Machine Learning Engineer to join our team. This job is for you if you like turning large, messy, heterogeneous experimental data into clean, labelled, trustworthy datasets. You have done this with scientific or industrial sensor data. Familiarity with fusion is a plus but not a strict requirement. Responsibilities Build, maintain and run pipelines that bring experimental fusion data into high quality, consistent, documented, versioned datasets. Develop ML-assisted labelling and event detection (e.g. disruptions, MHD activity, diagnostic faults), using weak supervision, active learning and anomaly detection. Own data quality and provisioning: provenance, calibration metadata, automated validation. Manage and facilitate access for the rest of the team. Work with physicists validating the datasets & labels. Work with our computational scientists and control engineers, who build models and controllers on these datasets, and with customers to understand and integrate their data. Requirements Hands-on experience building data pipelines for large scientific or industrial time-series data formats (e.g. HDF5, Parquet, Zarr). Proficiency in designing, querying and optimizing SQL and noSQL database systems and familiarity with Time Series databases such as TimescaleDB, InfluxDB.
